title: Informed Search: Heuristics and A*
overview: Use heuristic estimates of remaining cost to guide search toward the goal efficiently.
objectives: Explain greedy best-first search and its weaknesses

method.title: Heuristic function
method.body: h(n) estimates the cost from node n to the nearest goal, injecting domain knowledge into search.

method.title: Greedy best-first
method.body: Orders by h(n) alone; it is fast but neither complete in general nor optimal.

method.title: A* search
method.body: Orders by g(n)+h(n), balancing cost so far with estimated cost to go.

method.title: Optimality
method.body: A* returns an optimal solution when h is admissible (never overestimates), and with a graph-search explored set when h is also consistent.
